void.$description: Void — Page canvas, hero background, all primary surface area. Sets the dark-stage tone for every screen

bone.$description: Bone — Hairline borders, dividers, and muted secondary text. The workhorse neutral that defines edges without adding visual weight

paper.$description: Paper — Primary headings, body text, nav links, and icon strokes. Maximum contrast against Void for clear information hierarchy

graphite.$description: Graphite — Subtle nav borders and disabled/inactive state lines. Sits between Void and Bone for low-emphasis structural lines

spectrum-wash.$description: Spectrum Wash — Hero accent gradient — applied to a single headline word and the floating torus visual. Cool blue midpoint of the signature violet→blue→teal→lavender ramp

deep-field.$description: Deep Field — Footer band gradient origin — near-black indigo transitioning into brand blue. Defines the bottom-of-page atmospheric shift

atmospheric-fade.$description: Atmospheric Fade — Secondary gradient — blue-to-mint wash used in supporting visuals and transitional bands. Cooler, more subdued than the hero spectrum

valo.$description: Exclusive typeface across all UI: nav links, body copy, section labels, and display headlines. Weight 300 carries headlines and body — the anti-convention whisper-weight creates scientific authority through restraint. Weight 700 is reserved for micro-labels and the few moments that need to anchor a page. The custom cut of this single family is the brand voice.
